notes: v6.5 - The one-click update: (1) Nalox Connect - the panel now connects to your Chrome sign-in by itself. The Nalox Connect helper is inside the download; at first open the panel offers one Connect step, and downloads, clipping and song search just work. (2) A Tutorial section inside Settings plays the full setup video. (3) Song Finder previews play properly and now have a Stop button; download failures explain themselves in plain words. (4) NEW in Emoji & Sounds: Image Search - search any image (a heart, a Free Fire poster), pick from the grid, and it imports straight into your project. Your settings, keys and PRO unlock carry over.
